description: Realistic full-stack integration prompts that should trigger and exercise the quo (formerly OpenPhone) skill. Use with skill-evaluator / the skill-creator eval loop to benchmark with-skill vs baseline.

evals.name: send-sms-nextjs-server-route
evals.prompt: I'm building a Next.js app and want to text customers an order confirmation from my OpenPhone number when they check out. Wire up a server route that sends the SMS so my API key never hits the browser. My sending number is +14155550100.
evals.expected_output: Sends via POST https://api.quo.com/v1/messages from a SERVER-side route (App Router route handler / API route), with Authorization set to the RAW key (NO 'Bearer'), body { from, to: [E.164], content }. Notes that 'to' is exactly one E.164 recipient, content is 1-1600 chars, and the call returns 202 Accepted (queued) — delivery is async, confirmed via a message.delivered webhook or GET /v1/messages/{id}. Mentions US A2P 10DLC registration is required to send to US numbers. May use scripts/quo-client.mjs or scaffold-quo.mjs.

evals.name: verified-webhook-receiver-express
evals.prompt: Add a webhook endpoint to my Express server so I get notified when someone texts my Quo number, and make sure nobody can POST fake events to it.
evals.expected_output: Uses the BETA webhook API. Verifies the signature: HMAC-SHA256 base64 over `{webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}.{raw-body}` using the whsec_-prefixed signing secret (stripped + base64-decoded), comparing against the space-separated `v1,<sig>` entries in the webhook-signature header, with a ~5-min timestamp tolerance. Captures the RAW body (express.raw) BEFORE JSON parsing, de-duplicates on the webhook-id HEADER (not envelope id), and handles message.received. Ideally uses scripts/verify-webhook.js. Notes the secret is returned only at create/rotate time.

evals.name: two-way-sms-autoreply
evals.prompt: I want an SMS auto-responder with OpenPhone: when a customer texts our support line, automatically reply with a confirmation that we got their message. Full loop please.
evals.expected_output: Combines a verified beta webhook receiver (message.received) with a send call (POST /v1/messages). Reads the inbound text from event.data.resource.text and the sender from event.data.context (senderIdentifier / phoneNumberId), then replies with `from` = the Quo number and `to` = the sender. Stresses webhook signature verification, idempotency on webhook-id (so retries don't double-reply), acking 200 fast, the 10 req/s rate limit, and 202-async send semantics. Flags A2P registration for US.

evals.name: 401-auth-bearer-debug
evals.prompt: My OpenPhone API calls keep returning 401 Unauthorized. I'm setting the header to `Authorization: Bearer op_live_xxx` and hitting https://api.openphone.com/v1/phone-numbers. What's wrong?
evals.expected_output: Identifies the root cause: Quo/OpenPhone does NOT use a Bearer token — the Authorization header must be the RAW API key alone (`Authorization: op_live_xxx`), no 'Bearer ' prefix. Confirms api.openphone.com/v1 is a valid (alias) host (api.quo.com/v1 is canonical), so the host isn't the problem. May mention the key must be generated by a workspace owner/admin and that the live error body is {error:{message,key,trace}}.

evals.name: call-transcripts-and-contacts-crm
evals.prompt: We want to pull every call's AI summary and transcript into our CRM, and create/update a contact for each external caller. Walk me through the Quo endpoints and the gotchas.
evals.expected_output: Uses GET /v1/calls (requires phoneNumberId + participants + maxResults) with pageToken pagination (loop until nextPageToken is null; totalItems is inaccurate), then GET /v1/call-summaries/{callId} and GET /v1/call-transcripts/{id} — noting the transcript path param is `id` not `callId`, that both are business/scale-plan-gated, and that results are async (poll processingStatus until completed). For contacts: POST/PATCH /v1/contacts with the nested defaultFields/customFields shape (firstName required), upsert by externalId. Recommends subscribing to call.summary.completed / call.transcript.completed webhooks instead of polling. Auth is the raw key (no Bearer).
